about: The publish wasm (og_host_web-publish) after E6, 2026-10-19. brotli is scripts/check.sh size-gate's (-q 11 after wasm-opt -Oz); the shares are of the raw wasm's function bodies by the crate in each function's mangled name (generic code instantiated for a crate counts for it), so they apportion code, not compressed bytes.

atE6Start.note: 60 % of the budget when E6 began; 2,631,104 B (62 %) after og-nav and og-ai (249c76c); 2,859,083 B (68 %) after audio, platform and i18n; 2,862,533 B (68 %) at the end
